reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2026 oPt Emergency Appeal - West Bank - Protection

description.narrative: UNRWA will continue monitoring and documenting protection risks across the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, to inform advocacy, programming priorities and interventions. Support for vulnerable groups, including children, the elderly, persons with disabilities, and women and girls at risk of GBV, will be scaled up through community-based initiatives aimed at strengthening localised service delivery. The Agency will provide cash-for-protection to 600 individuals with urgent protection needs and distribute 600 assistive devices to persons with disabilities in the northern West Bank who lost essential equipment during displacement. UNRWA’s GBV response will provide legal aid to 150 women, PSS to 600 women and empowerment opportunities in safe spaces for 2,250 individuals, while also supporting child-friendly spaces, MHPSS for children affected by violence and displacement, and positive parenting initiatives. Accountability to affected populations and protection from sexual exploitation and abuse measures will be integrated throughout the response, supported by enhanced staff training and gender-, age- and disability-sensitive programming.
